_doc: Goal catalog. The seeder duplicates each goal once per matching Trackee:
- audience: "child" → one row per non-admin (Alice & Bob)
- audience: "adult" → one row per admin (Chad & Debbie)
- audience: "all"   → one unassigned row, visible to everyone
Categories are referenced by name; see categories.json.
Flat goals carry `points`; tiered goals carry `tierValues` (omit `points`).
`limitWindow` is one of day | week | month | lifetime. `completionLimit` is 1-999.
`usableAsRemediation` flags goals a Restricted kid can complete to lift a Restriction.

goals.name: Run around the block
goals.note: Run one full lap around the block without stopping. Counts once a day.

goals.name: Bike ride around the block
goals.note: Take a real ride around the block (not just to the driveway and back).

goals.name: 5 push-ups + 5 squats + 5 sit-ups
goals.note: Knock out a clean set: 5 push-ups, 5 squats, 5 sit-ups.

goals.name: Plank challenge
goals.note: Hold plank position. Pick a tier by total time held: 2 / 4 / 6 minutes.

goals.name: Stretch / yoga session (15 min)
goals.note: Do 15 minutes of stretching, yoga, or mobility work.

goals.name: Throw / catch with someone (10+ min)
goals.note: Play catch for at least 10 minutes with a parent or sibling. Any ball works.

goals.name: Backyard obstacle course
goals.note: Design an obstacle course, then run through it 3 times.

goals.name: Outdoor play
goals.note: Go outside and play for at least 20 minutes.

goals.name: Walk the dog
goals.note: Take the dog out for a real walk around the neighborhood.

goals.name: Hike
goals.note: Go on a real hike (solo or with the family).

goals.name: Swim session
goals.note: Pick a tier by what kind of session: open swim / lap practice / coached lesson.

goals.name: Read a book (independent)
goals.note: Read on your own. Pick a tier by minutes: 15 / 30 / 45.

goals.name: Read aloud to someone
goals.note: Read aloud to a sibling or parent for at least 15 minutes.

goals.name: Math practice
goals.note: Workbook page or math app. Pick a tier by minutes: 10 / 15 / 20.

goals.name: Khan / Duolingo streak
goals.note: Hit your daily streak on Khan, Duolingo, or a similar app.

goals.name: Instrument practice
goals.note: Practice your instrument. Pick a tier by minutes: 15 / 30 / 45.

goals.name: Finish a book
goals.note: Read all the way through a book and tell a parent about it.

goals.name: Journal entry
goals.note: Write a journal entry — at least 5 full sentences.

goals.name: Solve a puzzle (Rubik's, logic, jigsaw)
goals.note: Solve a puzzle: a Rubik's cube, a logic puzzle, or a jigsaw section.

goals.name: Typing practice (15 min)
goals.note: Spend 15 minutes on a real typing app (TypingClub, Nitro Type, etc.).

goals.name: Empty / load the dishwasher
goals.note: Fully unload (or load and start) the dishwasher.

goals.name: Take out trash / recycling
goals.note: Pull the bins out (or bring them back in) on collection day.

goals.name: Fold a load of laundry
goals.note: Fold a full load of laundry and put it away.

goals.name: Vacuum a room
goals.note: Vacuum one whole room (floor, edges, under furniture you can reach).

goals.name: Clean a bathroom
goals.note: Real clean: toilet, sink, mirror, floor. Tell a parent when it's ready to check.

goals.name: Tidy your room (15 min, timer)
goals.note: Set a 15-minute timer and tidy your room until it goes off.

goals.name: Wash the car
goals.note: Wash the car: rinse, soap, rinse, dry.

goals.name: Yard work (30 min: mow / rake / weed)
goals.note: 30 minutes of real yard work — mowing, raking, or weeding.

goals.name: Help with dinner prep
goals.note: Help cook dinner for at least 15 minutes — chopping, stirring, plating.

goals.name: Lego build
goals.note: Build with Lego. Pick a tier by scale: small / medium / large / real build / multi-day project.

goals.name: Drawing / painting session
goals.note: Draw or paint. Pick a tier: quick sketch / finished piece / frame-quality.

goals.name: Write a short story or poem
goals.note: Write something original. Pick a tier by length and polish.

goals.name: Bake something
goals.note: Bake from a recipe (parent supervision OK). Tiers: cookies / cake / multi-component.

goals.name: Build / craft project
goals.note: Build something from cardboard, paper, or whatever's around. Tiers reflect how finished it is.

goals.name: Code something (Scratch, Python)
goals.note: Write some code. Tiers: tutorial step / small project / a thing you'd actually share.

goals.name: Stop-motion or time-lapse video
goals.note: Make a finished 30+ second stop-motion or time-lapse clip.

goals.name: Write a thank-you note
goals.note: Write a real thank-you note (paper or card) and give or mail it.

goals.name: Random act of kindness
goals.note: Do something nice for someone without being asked. Tell a parent what you did.

goals.name: Volunteer hour
goals.note: Spend an hour volunteering — church, food bank, neighborhood cleanup, etc.

goals.name: Watch a creator tutorial + takeaway
goals.note: Watch a tutorial on camera work, editing, or hooks. Tell a parent one sentence you'll try next.

goals.name: On-camera speaking practice
goals.note: Record yourself talking on camera. Tiers by minutes: 5 / 10 / 20. Show the tape to a parent.

goals.name: Watch self on tape + 2 improvements
goals.note: Watch a clip of yourself and write down 2 things you want to do better next time.

goals.name: Write a video script / outline
goals.note: Write a script. Tiers: bullet outline / half-page script / full script with shot notes.

goals.name: Brainstorm 10 video ideas
goals.note: Write 10 video ideas. For each, include a one-line hook and how long it would be.

goals.name: Edit a finished clip
goals.note: Edit a clip under 60 seconds with cuts plus music or text. Tiers reflect polish.

goals.name: Publish a real short (≤60 sec)
goals.note: Record, edit, and publish a real short clip (60 seconds or less).

goals.name: Publish a long-form video (≥2 min)
goals.note: Record, edit, and publish a real video at least 2 minutes long.

goals.name: Shooting practice
goals.note: Form shots from spots. Pick a tier by minutes: 15 / 30 / 45.

goals.name: Free-throw challenge
goals.note: Count total made free throws in one session. Tiers: 10 / 25 / 50 makes.

goals.name: Dribbling drills (10 min)
goals.note: 10 minutes of dribbling drills — cones, between-legs, behind-back.

goals.name: Conditioning (suicides / sprints)
goals.note: Full set of suicides or court sprints.

goals.name: Watch a game + note 3 plays
goals.note: Watch a full game and write 3 plays: what happened and why it worked.

goals.name: Learn a new move (drill 20+ reps)
goals.note: Pick a new move or set play. Drill it 20+ times, then show a parent.

goals.name: 1-on-1 with parent or sibling
goals.note: Play 1-on-1 for at least 20 minutes.

goals.name: Pickup game / open run
goals.note: Play a pickup game or open run.

goals.name: Organized practice attended
goals.note: Attend a team practice or clinic. Showing up counts.

goals.name: Game played
goals.note: Play a real team game — league, tournament, or in-house.

goals.name: Strength training session (45+ min)
goals.note: 45+ minutes of real lifting — gym or home.

goals.name: Cardio session (30+ min)
goals.note: 30+ minutes of cardio: run, bike, row, or elliptical.

goals.name: Long run (5+ miles)
goals.note: Run at least 5 miles in one session.

goals.name: Mountain bike ride
goals.note: A real ride — trails, terrain, climbing. Not a neighborhood cruise.

goals.name: Yoga / mobility (30+ min)
goals.note: 30+ minutes of yoga, mobility, or stretching.

goals.name: Swim laps (30+ min)
goals.note: 30+ minutes of actual lap swimming.

goals.name: Hike (2+ hours, real terrain)
goals.note: Hike at least 2 hours on real terrain.

goals.name: Meditation / breathwork (10+ min)
goals.note: 10+ minutes of meditation or breathwork — sitting or moving.

goals.name: Read a book (independent)
goals.note: Independent reading. Pick a tier by minutes: 30 / 60 / 90.

goals.name: Finish a book
goals.note: Finish a book cover to cover.

goals.name: Online course / module
goals.note: Make real progress on a course — module finished, not just video on in the background.

goals.name: Language practice (15+ min)
goals.note: 15+ minutes on Duolingo, Anki, or another language app.

goals.name: Long-form article or paper (1500+ words)
goals.note: Read a long-form article or paper (1500+ words). Jot down 3 sentences on what stuck.

goals.name: Focused podcast (30+ min)
goals.note: Listen to 30+ minutes of a podcast with attention. Write a one-sentence takeaway.

goals.name: Side-project work session (60+ min)
goals.note: 60+ minutes of real progress on a side project.

goals.name: Write something substantial (30+ min)
goals.note: 30+ minutes of essay, blog, or journaling — not jotted notes.

goals.name: Learn a new technical skill (45+ min)
goals.note: 45+ minutes hands-on with a tutorial or new tool.

goals.name: Deep clean a room (45+ min)
goals.note: Real cleaning — surfaces, floor, edges. At least 45 minutes.

goals.name: Cook dinner from scratch
goals.note: Cook a meal from scratch (not reheating leftovers).

goals.name: Meal plan + grocery list
goals.note: Plan the week's meals and produce a shopping list.

goals.name: Grocery run
goals.note: Make a grocery run.

goals.name: Laundry — full cycle
goals.note: Wash → dry → fold → put away. Only counts if it's actually put away.

goals.name: Yard work (60+ min)
goals.note: 60+ minutes of yard work — mowing, weeding, trimming, leaves.

goals.name: Car maintenance
goals.note: Oil check, tire pressure, fluid top-up, wash, etc.

goals.name: Home repair / fix-it task
goals.note: A repair that's actually finished — not started or in-progress.

goals.name: Declutter a zone (fully sorted)
goals.note: Pick a zone and fully sort it — keep / donate / toss decisions made.

goals.name: Financial admin
goals.note: Bills, budget review, account checks.

goals.name: Knock out a "honey-do" task
goals.note: Pick something off the running honey-do list and finish it.

goals.name: Inbox / paperwork triage (30+ min)
goals.note: 30+ minutes of real triage — counts actually dropped.

goals.name: Cook a new recipe
goals.note: Try a recipe you've never cooked before, from a real source.

goals.name: Bake a real project
goals.note: Bread, cake, pastry — mixed yourself, not from a box.

goals.name: Cook for someone outside the household
goals.note: Cook a meal as hospitality or a gift for someone outside the house.

goals.name: Long-form writing (45+ min)
goals.note: 45+ minutes of real writing — essay, blog post, polished piece.

goals.name: Hands-on making (60+ min)
goals.note: 60+ minutes of real work on something with your hands — woodworking, sewing, craft.

goals.name: Art session (30+ min)
goals.note: 30+ minutes of drawing, painting, ceramics, or mixed media — not idle doodling.

goals.name: Garden / plant care (30+ min)
goals.note: 30+ minutes of real garden work — pruning, planting, harvesting.

goals.name: Real phone call (15+ min)
goals.note: 15+ minute call with a family member or friend. Texting doesn't count.

goals.name: Mentor / coach session
goals.note: A real session mentoring someone — career, life, sport, skill.

goals.name: Help a neighbor / friend with something real
goals.note: Time given to a neighbor or friend — moving, fixing, errands.

goals.name: Write a real letter or card
goals.note: Paper, signed, and in the mailbox. Counts when it's actually mailed.

goals.name: Donate (money, blood, goods, time)
goals.note: Donate money, blood, goods, or time — to someone outside the household.

goals.name: Date night / quality time (90+ min, phones away)
goals.note: 90+ minutes of intentional time with a partner, phones away.
